title: Hong Kong 100 – Introduction
claims: Hong Kong 100 starts at Pak Tam Chung in Sai Kung.
The course is 100 km and is based on the MacLehose Trail.
The finish is at Rotary Club Park on Tai Mo Shan Road.
The official course lists about 5,142 m of cumulative climb.
The finish descends from Tai Mo Shan, Hong Kong’s highest peak.
